start: A gym owner emailed asking to delete the gym

user_sees: Heading 'Delete requests'
'The privacy notice promises a delete within 30 days. Each step is written in the log.'
Card 'Write down a request that came another way'

steps.action: Pick the gym, 'Delete the whole gym', 'By email', leave 'Asked on' empty, tap 'Write it down'
user_sees: 'Open (1)' with the card '<gym> (<code>) · delete the whole gym'
'Asked <date> · day 1 of 30 · 29 days left'
Warning 'Not checked: anyone signed in to the gym’s admin app could have sent this. Call the owner on the gym’s own number first.'
must_not: The request dated other than today

steps.action: Tap 'I called the gym’s own number and the owner confirmed'
user_sees: 'Called the gym’s own number ✓ (<time>)'
The Not checked warning gone
must_not: The step ticked on another request

steps.action: Tap 'I reminded them to download their data first'
user_sees: 'Reminded them to download their data ✓ (<time>)'
The last step 'Delete: nothing can be brought back after this.'
must_not: The gym deleted by this tap

start: A gym owner sent a delete request from the admin app

user_sees: 'New from the admin app' with a card '<time> · from the admin app' and the owner's words
The Not checked warning
must_not: The request missing from this list with no word

user_sees: The request moves to 'Open (n)' dated when the owner sent it
must_not: The same admin app request listed again under New
The request dated today instead of when it was sent

start: A member phoned asking to be erased from one gym

steps.action: Pick the gym, 'Erase one member', type 'mobile ending 4321', 'By phone', tap 'Write it down'
user_sees: A card '<gym> (<code>) · erase a member: mobile ending 4321'
must_not: A whole-gym delete button on a member request

steps.action: Follow 'Open support access on the gym, find the member, and erase their details by hand (receipts stay: the law keeps them). Then:' and tap 'Done: the member is erased'
user_sees: The request moves to 'Closed (n)' as 'member mobile ending 4321 · done <time>'
must_not: The request closed before the member was really erased

start: Delete requests page with an admin app request for a gym code that no longer exists and a request on day 33

user_sees: 'No gym with that code. It may be deleted already.'
must_not: A 'Write it down' button for no gym

user_sees: 'day 33 of 30 · 3 days late' on a red card
must_not: A minus number of days left
A late request looking the same as a new one

steps.action: Tap 'Cancel the request', then Cancel in the question 'Cancel this delete request? Do this only when the gym told you it no longer wants the delete.'
user_sees: Nothing changes

start: An open delete request; the gym phoned to say they want to stay

steps.action: Type 'Owner changed mind on call' in 'Why it is cancelled', tap 'Cancel the request', OK
user_sees: 'Open (0)' and 'None open.'
'Closed (1)' with '<gym> (<code>) · gym · cancelled <time>'
must_not: The request still counted as open

user_sees: 'Cancelled a delete request' with the reason
must_not: No log line for the cancel

start: An admin app delete request not yet confirmed by phone

steps.action: Read the request and its Not checked warning before any step
user_sees: 'Not checked: anyone signed in to the gym’s admin app could have sent this. Call the owner on the gym’s own number first.'
